items.title: Weather forecast updated as of 2 May 2026 4:03pm
items.description:
##Weather##

Issued on Saturday, 02 May 2026 at 4:00pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Detailed forecast##

Rather cloudy this afternoon, possibly with an odd spot of rain, before a more persistent spell arrives this evening. Light southerly winds will back easterly, with temperatures around 12°C.

Rain continues overnight, with a minimum temperature around 9°C.


##Outlook##

Outbreaks of rain tomorrow morning, these clearing through the afternoon, but remaining fairly cloudy all day. Temperatures up to 15°C, in a light to moderate northeast wind.

A cloudy start to Bank Holiday Monday, but dry with sunny intervals developing. Light to moderate northerly winds with a top temperature up to 14°C.


##Sunrise##

5:38am Tomorrow

8:52pm Today
